Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CooldownHours_toolt: Minimum in-game hours between two supply drops, for the whole server.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_Frequency_tooltip: 0: a free frequency between 120 and 170 MHz, chosen by the server for this game and written on the military notes (players must find it). A fixed value is visible to every player. Rounded to the radio tuning step (0.2 MHz). 112.2 MHz is reserved.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DropMinDistance_too: Minimum distance in tiles between the player who calls and the drop point, chosen at random.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DropMaxDistance_too: Maximum distance in tiles between the player who calls and the drop point.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_AuthCode_tooltip: What players must give on the radio to get a drop. A weekly code changes every Monday at 00:00 (game calendar) and the previous one is still accepted for 24 hours. After 3 wrong codes in one day, the base ignores the caller until the next day.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_AuthCode_option2: Fixed code, in clear on the notes
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_AuthCode_option3: Weekly code, in clear on the notes
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_AuthCode_option4: Weekly code, encrypted (numbers station and codebook)
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_NumbersStationFrequ: 0: a free shortwave frequency between 10 and 25 MHz, chosen for this game (military radios, ham radios and the best civilian walkie-talkie). Never the military frequency nor 112.2 MHz. Encrypted weekly code only.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_MinZombies_tooltip: If minimum and maximum are both 0, no zombies spawn.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_MaxZombies_tooltip: Maximum number of zombies spawned around the crate.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CaseRolls_tooltip: Number of loot rolls for the crate: each roll can add a supply case.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_NoteDropRate_toolti: Chance for a dead zombie to carry a note with the military frequency and, depending on the code option, the code or the numbers station frequency.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_NotesOnlyArmyPolice: Notes only on military and police zombies
Only zombies whose outfit matches the list below can carry the notes.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_NoteOutfits_tooltip: Words searched in the zombie outfit name, separated by ; (also matches outfits from other mods).
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_NoteOutfitsExcluded: Outfits containing one of these words never carry notes, separated by ;.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CodebookDropRate_to: Chance for a dead military zombie to carry a codebook; also sets how often codebooks are found in army storage. Encrypted weekly code only.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CodebookOutfits_too: Words searched in the zombie outfit name, separated by ;. Excluded outfits also apply.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CrateSmokeMinutes_t: Needs the Signal Smoke mod: green smoke marks the crate when it lands, for this many in-game minutes. 0: no smoke. Without Signal Smoke, this option does nothing.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DebugLog_tooltip: Write detailed Military Drop messages to the console log.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_TrustDailyCap_toolt: Most trust a station (faction, or lone player) can earn per in-game day from reports, dog tags, missions and command post exchanges. Supply drops are not counted. 0: only drops change trust.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_TrustPostBonus_tool: Extra trust, in percent and rounded, for exchanges made from the station's command post. Still limited by the daily cap. 0: no bonus.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_TrustLineCutDays_to: When a station's trust falls under 15, the base refuses its drops for this many in-game days. It says so only to callers with the right frequency and code. 0: never cut.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_TrustDropLostHours_: In-game hours after the crate lands. If no supply case of the drop has been opened by then, the drop is lost and the calling station loses trust.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_TrustErosion_toolti: Each in-game day without any exchange with the base, a station's trust moves one point back toward its starting value (25).
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_ReportGain_tooltip: Trust gained by a station (faction or lone player) for its first situation report of the day, by radio on the military frequency. 0 disables it.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DogTagGain_tooltip: Trust gained for each fallen soldier's dog tag announced to the base (the game writes the soldier's name on it). Each name counts once and the tag is set aside; your own tag and blank tags do not count. 0 disables dog tags.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_ReconGain_tooltip: Trust gained by the first station that confirms a recon order from the announced grid (25 tiles at most). 0 disables recon orders.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_ReconHours_tooltip: In-game hours to confirm a recon order.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_ReconIntervalHours_: In-game hours after a recon order closes before the next one (plus or minus 25 percent).
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CleanupGain_tooltip: Trust gained by the station that brings down the most zombies of the announced horde (within 40 tiles of the grid), once 90 percent of the horde is dead. Only horde zombies killed by players count for a station; fire and traps only bring the horde down. 0 disables clearance orders.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CleanupHours_toolti: In-game hours to bring down 90 percent of the horde.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CleanupQuota_toolti: Zombies of the horde that appears in the announced zone when a player first comes near. The order is fulfilled when 90 percent of them are dead.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_CleanupIntervalHour: In-game hours after a clearance order closes before the next one (plus or minus 25 percent).
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_ControlGain_tooltip: Trust gained by every station that confirms reception of a radio check in time, once each. 0 disables radio checks.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_ControlIntervalHour: In-game hours after a radio check closes before the next one (plus or minus 25 percent).
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DecoyEnabled_toolti: The requisition form offers a decoy drop: a crate with a siren that draws the dead to a sector you choose. It looks exactly like a real drop.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DecoyCost_tooltip: Requisition points spent on a decoy drop.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DecoySirenHours_too: In-game hours the decoy siren sounds after the crate lands, until its batteries run out. A player can switch it off sooner.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_DecoyNoiseRadius_to: Distance at which zombies hear the decoy siren. Only while the area around the crate is loaded.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_RequisitionForm_too: After a valid call, the caller fills a requisition form and chooses the supplies with a point budget. Off: random supply cases, as before. Admin drops never use the form.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_RequisitionBudget_t: Scales the point budget of the form. At 100: 8 points at trust 25, 12 at 50, 16 at 75, 20 at 100. Unspent points are lost.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_RequisitionCostMult: Scales the cost of every lot, rounded, at least 1 point.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_RequisitionTier2_to: Trust needed to order ammunition, melee weapons, protection, mechanics, signals, seeds, training and packs.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_RequisitionTier3_to: Trust needed to order firearms, weapon attachments, explosives and fuel.
Sandbox_MilitaryDrop_RequisitionExplosiv: Lets callers order explosives in the requisition form.
